ownership.businessAuthority: Reserved notification authority for email, SMS, push, and commerce lifecycle messaging.

observabilityAuthority.audit: notification dispatches must retain template, recipient, and provider event references without secret payloads

executionAuthority.executionRole: Execution container for APIs, workers, webhooks, schedulers, queue consumers, and runtime bootstrapping.
executionAuthority.orchestrationRole: Delegates business workflow sequencing to packages/application-services; owns transport invocation and runtime transactions only.
executionAuthority.infrastructureOwnership: May wire packages/infrastructure adapters to runtime bindings and secrets; does not import provider SDKs directly.
executionAuthority.eventOwnership: Owns runtime event ingestion, dispatch, acknowledgement, and handler execution for declared service responsibilities.
executionAuthority.queryOwnership: May execute service-side read models through application-services or runtime-composition contracts.
executionAuthority.compositionOwnership: No UI composition authority; composes execution handlers and response envelopes only.
